Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

I. All G are R.

II. Some F are G.

**Conclusions:**

I. All R are F.

II. Some G are F.

III. Some F are R

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
From the given statements, we draw the Venn diagram as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/268ff8a8cf5d0cb5854578c0eb7ae13d5008134f9ccbb7e02ca1365351df4976.png] 

Next, we will check the conclusions

I. All R are F → Unfollows: Since given that some F are G and all G are F. So, all R are F is not possible. This is not true.

II. Some G are F → Follows: Since some F are G is given and so some G are F is true.

III. Some F are R → Follows: Since given that some F are G and all G are F. So, some F are R is possible. This is true.

Thus, only **conclusions II and III** follow.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

26 ÷ 24 + 6 × 27 − 105 = 29
questions.solution:
Bodmas Table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given: 26 ÷ 24 + 6 × 27 − 105 = 29

Now,

Checking the options:

Option 1) + and − 

after replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow **__26 ÷ 24__** - 6 × 27 + 105 = 29

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

Rightarrow 1.08 - **__6 × 27__** + 105 = 29

Rightarrow __**1.08**__ - 162 __**+ 105**__ = 29

Rightarrow __**106.08 - 162**__ = 29

= -55.92 ≠ 29.

 

**Option 2) ÷ and +**

after replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow 26 + __**24 ÷ 6**__ × 27 − 105 = 29

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

Rightarrow 26 + __**4**____** × 27**__ − 105 = 29

Rightarrow __**26 + 108**__ - 105 = 29

Rightarrow **__134 - 105__** = 29

**= 29 = 29 True**

 

3) + and × 

after replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow 26 × 24 + __**6 ÷ 27**__ − 105 = 29

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

Rightarrow __**26 ×**____** 24**__ + 0.22 − 105 = 29

Rightarrow __**624 + 0.22**__ − 105 = 29

Rightarrow __**624.22 - 105**__ = 29

= 519.22 ≠ 29.

 

4) ÷ and −

after replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow 26 - 24 + 6 × __**27 ÷ 105**__ = 29

Applying the BODMAS rule, we will get,

Rightarrow 26 - 24 + __**6 × 0.25**__ = 29

Rightarrow __**26**__ - 24 __**+ 1.5**__ = 29

Rightarrow **__27.5 - 24__** = 29

= 3.5 ≠ 29.

So, the signs '__**÷ and +**__' interchanged to make the equation correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

Rightarrow 0.025 + 13 − __**4 × 111**__ = 119

Rightarrow __**0.025**____** + 13**__ − 444 = 119

Rightarrow **13.025 - 444** = 119

= - 430.9 ≠ 119.

 

Option 2) ÷ and × 

After replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow 2 + 78 × 13 − __**4 ÷ 111**__ = 119

Rightarrow 2 +__** 78 **____**×**____** 13**__ − 0.036 = 119

Rightarrow __**2 + 1014**__ − 0.036 = 119

Rightarrow __**1016 - 0.036**__ = 19

= 1015.9 ≠ 119.

 

Option 3) + and -

After replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow 2 - __**78 ÷ 13**__ + 4 × 111 = 119

Rightarrow 2 - 6 + __**4 × 111**__ = 119

Rightarrow __**2**__ - 6 __**+ 444**__ = 119

Rightarrow __**446 - 6**__ = 19

= 440 ≠ 119.

After replacing the symbols:

Rightarrow 2 × __**78 ÷ 13**__ − 4 + 111 = 119

Rightarrow __**2 ×**____** 6**__ − 4 + 111 = 119

Rightarrow __**12**__ − 4 __**+ 111**__ = 119

Rightarrow __**123 - 4**__ = 119

**= 119 = 119 True**

Similarly,

(30, 8, 11) → (30 - 8) ÷ 2 = 22 ÷ 2 = 11.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
